title: Automatically delete next events, goals, reminders
body:
Google Calendar automatically delete all my next events, goals, reminders,... on my iPhone 8 plus and web version.
____

Hi Google Calendar team,

I feel sad due to the Google Calendar reaction during last weeks so far. It has taken me a lot of time to adjust my goals, events I set for the whole months and next ones again and again. 

For example: I set " Do yoga" everyday on last couple weeks, but it stop from yesterday until May 23rd 2020. The problem happens to other goals I set. 

And today, when I cancel a individual event, It automatically delete all other events of the  year.

I use Google Calendar to manage my times. Due to this problems, it makes me spend a lot of time more than ever, just for managing time while I need to work.

Hope you guys can help me fix this problems.

Thanks a lot.

Stay safe.

Ngoc.
